text:
Marta Gomez: Heads-up: launching leadflow blog + webinar landing tomorrow AM. Need a compact ops checklist focused on SEO technicals: keyword mapping, schema variants (Event vs WebPage), internal linking plan from docs, and redirects for legacy campaign URLs. Can we do a 30-min async wire?

Jordan Lee: I'll map primary keyword clusters. My preliminary pick: primary = \"inbound lead routing\", secondary = \"leadflow product\", long-tail = \"automated lead routing for SaaS\". Will share anchor suggestions.

Faisal Khan: Redirect note: we still have legacy campaign paths like /campaigns/lead-q1 and some tracked variants with ?src=partner. Recommend a canonicalization middleware that strips known utm params and issues 301 -> /product/leadflow. Also watch for query-preserving redirects we used last year.

Priya Patel: Schema plan: include Event JSON-LD for webinar, plus BreadcrumbList on the blog post, and a lightweight FAQPage JSON-LD so SERP can show Q+A. For the landing itself, add WebPage + mainEntity (FAQ) so Google sees the registration CTA.

Alex Chen: I'll run a quick crawl and export the top 10 inbound pages that should link to the new post. Expect docs/getting-started, integrations, partner-network, and the pricing FAQ. I'll paste anchor-text suggestions after crawl.

Jordan Lee: Anchor suggestions (short):
- integrations -> \"integrations with Leadflow\"
- docs/getting-started -> \"set up inbound lead routing\"
- partner-network -> \"lead routing partners\"
- pricing FAQ -> \"Leadflow pricing and limits\"
- support article -> \"troubleshoot routing rules\"

Faisal Khan: Nginx redirect snippet for ops (temp 302 for smoke, then 301):
```nginx
# canonicalize campaign paths
rewrite ^/campaigns/lead-q1/?$ /product/leadflow? permanent;
# strip utm params at edge using lambda/cache layer before redirect
```
I'll coordinate with infra on edge param stripping.

Priya Patel: JSON-LD examples (short):
Event (webinar):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Leadflow: Scaling Inbound Routing","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
FAQPage example will include 3 Qs and live in the blog template include.

Marta Gomez: Also add robots/x-robots tag? We want the blog indexed quickly; ensure noindex is not set on staging. Who manages templates?

Alex Chen: Template owner is @Faisal (web team). I'll verify robots and sitemap inclusion. Also will add the new URL to the weekly sitemap push and ping search console.

Faisal Khan: Confirmed templates: production blog template includes index by default. I will add the JSON-LD blocks to the blog layout and the landing layout. Scheduling sitemap ping after deploy.

Jordan Lee: Small copy ask: ensure H1 includes primary keyword exactly once: \"Inbound lead routing\". We'll use variations in H2s.

Priya Patel: Suggest we A/B the FAQ visibility: collapsed vs inline for 14 days to measure impressions & CTR. I'll add tracking pixels for SERP snippet clicks.

Marta Gomez: Perfect. Final ops priority for tonight: 1) redirect middleware to strip utm and 301, 2) add Event + FAQ JSON-LD to landing, 3) internal links from top 8 referrers, 4) sitemap & Search Console ping, 5) confirm robots and canonical headers. Can each owner confirm?

Jordan Lee: Confirmed. I'll add anchor assignments in the internal link sheet.

Faisal Khan: Confirmed. I'll deploy redirect rule to staging for smoke and push to prod after tests.

Priya Patel: Confirmed. JSON-LD saved to /docs/seo/snippets and linked in the PR. Will monitor rich result status.

Alex Chen: Confirmed. Crawl + sheet updated, will follow up post-deploy with a short report.

Marta Gomez: Thank you team 680. I'll coordinate postlaunch checks at +2h and +24h. If anything blocks, ping in #marketing-urgent.

Jordan Lee: quick reminder: use canonical link rel on all tracked campaign landing copies to point to /product/leadflow to consolidate signals.

Faisal Khan: noted. Also will ensure edge CDN respects canonical headers and doesn't cache query variants as separate items.

Priya Patel: adding monitoring: impressions, rich result presence, and clicks for 7 days.

Marta Gomez: Great. That's the checklist. Closing thread.
